label.description: The label that will be used by any series that use this dataset.

timestampField.description:
The field that represents the time of the event. Use to determine the x value of each event
point in the chart.

fieldLabels.description:
An array of pairs of strings that determines the field labels for this event dataset.
These both determine what is shown in the tooltip when hovering an event and the labels
for the values in the tooltip.

title: Represents a dataset for events to be plotted in a {@link UiApTimeseriesChart}.
name: UiApTimeseriesChartEventDataset
